Dialogs.Dialog: Anegasaki
Hey, are you secretly, like, super amazing？
Eh？
Solving that so easily... Maybe you really are a genius.
You don't have to praise me so much.
At this rate, you'll be a scientist or professor, making huge inventions...
winning big awards, becoming world-famous, getting swarmed with interviews...
Um... ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
If that happens, we won't have any time together.
Studying is great, but... pay attention to me, too, okay？
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s eyes... She's dead serious...)
(That chemistry lab presentation went great! Even the teacher looked surprised...)
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲。
Hm, what's wrong？
Yeah... You really are amazing, after all.
...You think so？
You are. That's why I...
I don't even know how many times I can fall for you all over again.
(All right! I'm gonna keep giving it my all!!)
Anegasaki
Hey, teach me how you study, too？
Sure, but I don't think I'm doing anything special, you know？
If I copy you, maybe I'll get good at math and science too.
Ah! You just made a 'no way' face!
I did not!
You did too. To make up for it, you have to tutor me until I get it, okay？
I'll try my best...
Anegasaki
Don't go getting any smarter than that.
Eh？
I'll lose my place as your upperclassman.
Well...
Hehe, look at you flustered. So cute▼
Sorry. You're just so good at it, I got a little jealous.
Jealous of what？
Numbers, formulas, textbooks, and...
(A perfect score on a pop physics quiz... ●'s pretty good!)
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. You aren't pushing yourself too hard, are you？
I'm not. Why do you ask？
When your boyfriend is an overachiever, a girl can't help but worry.
...Is that how it works？
I'm fine. I'm not pushing myself.
Then that's okay. Good job▼
Anegasaki
I really like science guys.
Really？
Yeah. I'm totally useless with that sort of thing.
Then maybe ● should aim for that, too.
I'm talking about you, you know？
...You are？
Or maybe... I just like it because it's you.
(A science guy, huh...)
Anegasaki
Incredible! You got a perfect score on your Chinese poetry test!
Haha. It was just a streak of good luck, mostly...
Nuh-uh. I know full well it's all your own skill, you know？
You're allowed to brag a little when you do well. Come on, show off a bit!
Well then... How do ya like that!
Hehe. You did such a good job▼
Anegasaki
Word in the teachers' room is that your modern lit report was totally flawless, you know？
Haha, I guess so.
Looks like there's no room for me to help at all. I feel kind of left out.
No, no way, I'm still totally relying on you!
...Really？
Yeah, really.
You'll rely on me？
Of course I will.
Hehe, okay then. I'd better work even harder for you, too.
Anegasaki
Want me to recommend some good study guides？
Oh, that'd be a big help.
Hehe, times like this, I'm really glad I'm a year older than you.
Why？
Because you're just so good at everything.
If I didn't have a one-year head start, there's no way I could keep up with you.
I'm not that great...
It's true, you know？
Still, being a year ahead, I'm glad there are things I can teach you.
(I'm feeling so motivated... I'll keep giving it my all!)
Anegasaki
Hard at work？ Very good.
Well, managing somehow.
Look at you being modest. I heard the teacher praised you in class earlier, you know？
Whoa, word travels fast.
I have a special superpower that picks up info about you right away.
A superpower just for ●？
That's right, just for you. Hehe.
Anegasaki
Are you sure you didn't time-travel here from ancient times？
Wait, what？
There aren't many people today who can read classical Japanese that smoothly, you know？
Oh, absolutely. You're practically bilingual at this point!
...Is it really that amazing？
Amazing doesn't even begin to cover it. It's suuuuuper amazing! Hehe▼
(I'm so glad I put in all that hard work...!)
(A hundred on the kanji test, and I answered every question... Alright, nailed it!)
Anegasaki
Hard at work？ Very good.
Yes, Miss Anegasaki!
Don't let your guard down, okay？ You've gotta keep this up.
All right~
Hehe. Very well done, ▼
Anegasaki
I saw that picture you painted.
I thought it turned out pretty well. What did you think？
It was wonderful... Like it gave my heart a little squeeze.
It's so warm and gentle, I feel like I could look at it forever.
...That much？
Yeah. I really love it.
(Sweet! All that hard work really paid off.)
Anegasaki
They say your artwork shows how you were feeling at the time, though...
...Hmm？
Whenever I look at your art, it just makes me feel so happy.
Does that mean... ● was feeling happy？
Haha, yeah, that's right.
Thanks to ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, of course.
...Geez. Now it feels like I forced you to say that.
Still, if that's true, does that make this our joint creation... maybe？
(...Man, she's making me blush.)
Anegasaki
Whoa, that painting is quite the masterpiece, isn't it？
For something I did so fast, I think it turned out pretty well.
Yeah, it's really lovely. I almost want to hang it in my room.
Hearing ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ praise it makes it really look like a masterpiece.
Hehe. Anyone who sees it would think it's great, okay？
Is that so？
Yup！
Anegasaki
Hey, why not take proper lessons？
For art？
Yeah. It's a waste to only draw in class.
I'm no expert, but I really think you've got talent.
Hearing ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ say that makes me feel like I really could...
I'm serious, you know？ If you do, I'll be cheering with all I've got, okay？
...Yeah. Thanks.
Anegasaki
Whoa... You really put a lot into that painting, didn't you？
Oh, you can tell？
Yeah. Because it looks ready to jump right out at you.
Jump out？
Yep. Like, 'ROAAAR!'
It's a landscape, though...
I know, but it feels like a beast could jump out from the shadows! It's so real！
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s imagination is pretty wild too...)
Anegasaki
It's quite a unique piece, isn't it？ Very 'you', I guess you could say.
What do you mean by 'like ●'？
Let's see... Gentle, cute, and kind of endearing...
Yeah.
Plus, you're pretty quick-witted, right？
...Yeah？
Plus, you can be surprisingly manly, too...
(She IS talking about the painting, right？)
Anegasaki
Music really comes down to natural talent, huh...
You think so？
Effort matters, of course, but having natural talent is what really counts.
And you're just overflowing with natural talent.
Oh, you are. I guarantee it.
...Really？
Yup. I've totally become a fan of yours.
I'm your precious first fan, so you'd better treat me really well, okay？
Haha.
Anegasaki
Uh-huh, working hard, huh？
Haha, yeah, I guess.
Well then, as a reward for working so hard--
Hehe. Now what were you expecting just now？
Huh？ N-No, nothing really...
Well, fine then. We'll leave it at that.
Eh！？
Huh？ Um... were you expecting THAT big of a reward？
(Well, uh...)
Anegasaki
I kind of wish music class would just disappear.
Huh, why's that？
Because... you look so cool whenever you sing.
It feels like a waste showing you off to everyone. I want you all to myself.
(...Is she jealous？)
Anegasaki
You look like you're having so much fun singing.
Did it look that way？
Yup. You were super cute, ▼.
Cute...？
Hehe. Just thinking about it, I just... hehehe.
Hmm...
Aw, you look so conflicted. Even that face is cute, ▼.
(This is embarrassing...)
(All right! That was perfect!)
Anegasaki
Ugh, this isn't fair...
Eh？
Your singing and playing were both perfect! I guess that's what they mean by totally flawless.
Are you talking about ●？
Of course I am!
Haha, you're exaggerating.
Not at all! You had such a wonderful look on your face, so charming...
You're just making me fall for you even harder. Geez, what am I gonna do？
(Man, I'm blushing... But I'm really glad I gave it my all!)
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. How was ●？
Anegasaki
Hehe, like you don't already know.
I want to hear it straight from ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
...You were really, really good▼
Really？
Yeah. So poised and full of confidence... I wish I could sing like that, too.
(All right!)
Anegasaki
Hehe. Working hard, I see.
Haha, I guess so.
Still, if you push yourself too hard, I start to worry.
You know, like getting hurt...
I'll be fine. You're such a worrywart.
Well, of course I am. It's you, after all.
I know I worry too much, but... please be careful, okay？
I won't do anything reckless to make you worry, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Yeah, ▼.
Anegasaki
Got energy to burn？
Does it look like it？
Yeah. You're so energetic, looks like you're about to take off.
Haha, yeah, I might still have some steam to blow off.
Then why don't you give the extra to me？
...How？
Hold my hand？
Ah, here it comes! I feel energized already!
Haha.
All right!
Anegasaki
Incredible!
Oh, you were watching？
I sure was! You were so fast in that marathon, weren't you？
I think I might've set a new personal best.
Really？ That's amazing!!
...Oh geez, all I've been saying is 'amazing' this whole time, huh？
If it's from you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, I'd happily hear it a hundred times.
Hehe.▼
Anegasaki
Amazing! A three-pointer with one second left？ You looked like a pro!
That was just luck, mostly. The pass was timed really well.
Even so, it's not easy to pull off. Right？
Yeah, I guess so.
You really were amazing!!
Aw, come on...
Jeez... Just how cool do you plan on getting？
(This is embarrassing...)
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you were there？
Anegasaki
I was cheering for you the whole time, you know？
Huh, cheering？
Aww, you didn't hear me？ What a shame...
Sorry...
Hehe, it's fine. Just means you were that focused, right？
Giving it everything when it counts. That's what I love about you, after all.
Anegasaki
I was watching! You were incredible out there.
Yeah, I'm on a roll today!
*Sigh*... I really wish we were in the same grade.
Eh？
That way, I'd get to see you shine a whole lot more, wouldn't I？
You might catch me looking not so cool, though？
But that's not what I want...
Hehe, when it's you, I think I'd love seeing any side of you▼
Anegasaki
Hey, now. Don't go doing everything by yourself.
Eh？
Leave some work for your big sister, will you？ I'll have nothing to do.
Haha.
Hehe. Just kidding, having you here is really a lifesaver.
I'll keep counting on you from now on too, okay？
(All right, I'll keep giving it my all to live up to her expectations!)
Anegasaki
I saw that, you know. The customer said your service was great, didn't they？
That was just luck... More like they said it for all of us, really...
Hehe, so modest. You did a wonderful job.
Just lean on me sometimes, okay？ Don't push yourself too hard all alone.
Yeah.
Good boy.
Hehe, you really are my underclassman like that.
What's that supposed to mean？
The cute part, of course▼
Anegasaki
Great work today.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you too.
I got to take it easy today, all thanks to you.
Really？
Yeah. You beat me to it before I can even start on anything.
Haha, first come, first served.
Hehe, listen to you.
I can't even remember what it was like around here before you joined.
Why？
That's how much I rely on you▼
(Man... I'd better keep working hard to live up to her expectations!)
Anegasaki
Working with you is so much fun.
Haha, especially today, since everything's going so smoothly!
Getting a lot done is nice, but that's not all of it, you know？
Eh？
It's fun because it's you. Nobody else could ever take your place.
I-Is that so？
Aw, you're blushing. You're so cute▼
(● is completely perfect today!)
Anegasaki
Amazing! You're completely perfect today.
Haha, ●, I was just thinking the same about you.
Hehe, look at that face. It makes me happy too.
Though... maybe it's a little bit of a waste？
What？
I kind of wish I could keep that look on your face all to myself, though...
(...Man, she's making me blush.)
(Phew... We made it through!)
Anegasaki
Good work today. You really saved me so many times.
Good work to you too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Not at all. I was leaning on you the entire time.
I'll keep counting on you from now on, okay？
Yeah, leave it to me!
Hehe, look at you, getting so dependable...▼
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲。
Ah, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
What's wrong？
Ah, sorry. Now that you're up close, I got all flustered...
I was already thinking how cool you looked swimming out there, but...
even just standing there, you look so handsome...▼
(If we're talking looks, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is way more...)
Anegasaki
You won that relay by a mile!
Everyone on the team did a great job passing it off to me.
When you crossed the line in first place, I almost screamed.
What was that？
'The guy who just finished is my boyfriend! Isn't he so cool？'
Mmm, I still want to! I'm gonna brag to my friends about you later.
(Seeing her this happy... Giving it my all was totally worth it.)
